issues.issue: Did the officer breach procedural fairness by refusing an oral hearing without giving reasons?
issues.applicant_position: Requested an oral hearing under s.113(b) if credibility was in issue; officer gave no reasons for refusing it.
issues.respondent_position: Officer properly excluded new evidence under s.113(a), ending credibility issues; a hearing would not have changed the result.
issues.result_quote: the failure to provide adequate reasons for the decision not to hold a hearing constitutes a breach of procedural fairness
